data.body: AC amendment: TRANSITION BEHAVIOR — validate-review-output.sh must NOT immediately reject scores key in this story (Story 1). The reviewer agents still emit scores until Story 2 (f19a-c97e). Instead, validate-review-output.sh should: (1) ACCEPT 2-key schema {findings, summary} without scores — this is the new behavior to test and verify, (2) Continue TOLERATING 3-key schema {scores, findings, summary} with a deprecation warning to stderr, (3) Update comment that scores is being deprecated. The done definition 'rejects files containing a scores key' applies to the FINAL state after Story 2 updates all agent files. This ensures the review pipeline remains functional during the transition between Story 1 and Story 2.
